name: Sabrina
source:
Sabrina is an enigmatic Psychic Pokémon trainer with esper-like powers. She is reclusive and quiet girl with little desire to be in public eye.

Sabrina was first introduced in Pokémon Red, Pokémon Blue and Pokémon Green versions.
